_meta: Fable-5 in-session compile of telecom main_policy.md (158 lines) — S1 teacher spec. Mirror of retail/airline gate structure: auth-first + db_check preconditions + price-confirm + transfer-notice. Acceptance: Track-A replay (verifier TBD for telecom) or P5 cross-compile agreement; bootstrap teacher trusted (P-A2-0 airline replay-clean evidences Fable-5 compile fidelity).

G1_AUTH_FIRST.ask: identify the customer first (phone, customer id, or full name + date of birth), then retry
G1_AUTH_FIRST.note: technical support and every account-scoped action require identifying the customer first

G2_CONFIRM_PRICE.predicate: explicit user confirmation of the price
G2_CONFIRM_PRICE.ask: state the price to the user and obtain explicit confirmation before applying

G3_BILL_OVERDUE.predicate: the target bill is in OVERDUE status
G3_BILL_OVERDUE.terminal: deny: a payment request may only be sent for a bill confirmed OVERDUE (the tool does not check this)
G3_BILL_OVERDUE.db_check: bill.status == OVERDUE AND no other bill is AWAITING_PAYMENT for the customer

G4_RESUME_ELIGIBLE.predicate: all overdue bills paid AND the line contract end date is not in the past
G4_RESUME_ELIGIBLE.terminal: deny: a line may be resumed only after all overdue bills are paid; never if the contract end date is in the past
G4_RESUME_ELIGIBLE.db_check: all customer bills.status != OVERDUE AND line.contract_end_date >= today

G5_REFUEL_LIMIT.terminal: deny: the maximum data that can be refueled is 2GB

G6_TRANSFER_MSG.predicate: the mandatory transfer notice has been communicated to the user
G6_TRANSFER_MSG.ask: send the user exactly: 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' — then retry the transfer
